answer: A field-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via time-gated optical retroreflection. Verifiers fire nonce-coded laser pulses at a peer's coordinates, and the agent tilts a MEMS mirror to modulate and return the beam within nanosecond bounds. Rejecting shared bearings and overlapping delays forces attackers to build and power separate optical rigs at distinct sites per identity. Yet mist or swaying cedar limbs near an orchard block line of sight and cause false rejections.
